description.value: McBride & District Public Library is a community hub in the small Robson Valley town of McBride, situated along the Yellowhead Highway in BC's Central Interior. The library offers computer and internet access, a Library of Things, a seed library, and meeting room rentals — practical resources for touring cyclists passing through this remote region. It also maintains a satellite reading room in the hamlet of Dome Creek further up the valley, and hosts local history and oral history projects rooted in the area's railway and ranching heritage.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the library is active and operating, with current programs, staff contacts, and a full service menu. The OSM tag internet_access=wlan combined with the website's explicit 'Computer & Internet Use' and 'One-on-One Computer & Internet Lessons' service listings provides strong corroboration for Wi-Fi availability. None of the required cycling criteria (bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all remain null pending a site visit or direct inquiry.
concerns: OSM opening hours differ from website: OSM records Tuesday evening hours (19:00–21:00) and Friday close at 20:00, while the website shows Tue–Thu 10am–6pm and Fri 12pm–4pm — OSM data appears outdated.
OSM address omits city name; full address '521 Main Street, McBride BC V0J 2E0' taken from website footer.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a plausible rest stop for touring cyclists along the Yellowhead Highway and offers confirmed Wi-Fi, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be verified from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed before inclusion.

wow_evidence: Community library with Library of Things and seed library (KW-PRIVATE is a meeting-room false positive).
blurb: McBride's public library, with seed library and gear lending.
